Story.headline: Theory Alone Is Often Not Enough to Get Hired.
Story.p1: Many formal classes or education only focus on theory. You might memorize the concepts, but when asked to build a real app by a recruiter, you get confused. As a result, your job application is often ignored due to lack of practical experience.
Story.p2: E17 Course is here to change the way you learn. We bring industry standards into every module. With the Complete Package, you don't just watch theory, but directly build real projects alongside professional mentors.
Story.p3: The result? You graduate much more prepared. For Complete Package students, you will have a solid portfolio that makes HR notice you.

Benefits.b1_desc: Get knowledge directly from industry professionals. They know exactly what kind of code passes company standards.
Benefits.b2_desc: Leave boring tutorials behind. Learn by building real apps that you can show off on your resume right away.
Benefits.b3_desc: From structured learning guides to mentor support for Complete Package students, all materials are designed to get you ready to enter the tech industry.

TentangKami.desc: Learn more about the vision, mission, and team behind E17 Course.
TentangKami.hero_desc: E17 Course was founded with one main mission, bridging the gap between education and the real needs of the tech industry.
TentangKami.why_p1: We realize that the tech industry evolves much faster than traditional education curriculums. Many young talents graduate but struggle to find jobs because their skills are not relevant to market needs.
TentangKami.why_p2: Therefore, E17 Course was born as a real solution. We don't just teach what is "good to know", but we focus on what is "must have" in the workplace.
TentangKami.why_p3: We believe that anyone can become a reliable digital talent as long as they are provided with the right environment, materials, and mentoring.
TentangKami.v1_desc: We don't just teach, we prepare you to be absorbed by the industry with relevant skills.
TentangKami.v2_desc: Our curriculum is designed to accelerate understanding. Cut unnecessary theory, add more practice.
TentangKami.v3_desc: Learn together in a supportive environment. You will be guided by professional mentors.
TentangKami.v4_desc: Our materials are always updated following the latest tech trends and job market needs.
TentangKami.val_subtitle: These principles guide every decision we make in designing and delivering our curriculum.
